name: Bun do
summary: Thick red noodles in a broth of pork bone and crab, topped with a crab-and-pork cake, quail egg, fried shallot, and pork crackling. The orange-red comes from hạt điều, and the blanched greens and shrimp paste come on the side.
origin: Vietnam National Administration of Tourism and Bao Dak Lak both treat bún đỏ as the bowl that marks Buon Ma Thuot.
howToEat: Stir in shrimp paste and ground chili, then add the blanched water celery, sweet mustard greens, and bean sprouts. Stalls open from about 15:00 or 16:00 and run into the evening.
where: Le Hong Phong has a row of stalls. Phan Boi Chau, Phan Dinh Giot, Le Duan, and the night market sell it too.
seoTitle: Bun do in Buon Ma Thuot — red noodles on Le Hong Phong
seoDescription: Thick red noodles in a pork-and-crab broth, with crab cake, quail egg, and pork crackling, on Le Hong Phong from about 15:00.
